title: Wgpu Panel Glass Blur
description: Restore real frosted-glass panels in the wgpu renderer (side panel, context menus/dropdowns, window measures/engagement rails) via GPU backdrop-blur + saturate + tint composite.
summary: Fixed wgpu glass-blur pipeline end-to-end. Root causes: (1) blur_globals uniform buffer was 16 bytes but WGSL required 32 — expanded Rust BlurGlobals padding and set min_binding_size; (2) after world3d passes ui_pipeline kept world3d_bind_group bound — restore glyph_bind_group in draw_world_pass_at and draw_vector_vertices; (3) WebGPU rejected scene_color used as render attachment and texture binding in the same command buffer — split frame into scene + composite submits, added blur_scratch texture with per-mip copy before downsample, and submit each blur mip separately. Verified via headless Playwright: zero WebGPU warnings, canvas renders fully (maxLuma 235).
